main_body: Round stone tower with a green conical shingle roof, a gold finial, a framed window with flower box, and an arched wooden door
top_band: Green shingle roof slope, rows 4-38 (L about 99-152 in scalloped rows). It sits above a dark eave at rows 39-41 and the stone front face below.
evidence: The column scan at x=23 runs from the gold finial through the roof slope (rows 4-38, scalloped green) to a dark eave and brown lip (rows 39-41), then the grey stone face from row 42. The cone roof reads as a large visible sloped surface, as the reference house roofs do. The dark eave and brown lip mark the front edge and shade the wall. The window has a frame and sill, and the door has a stone surround and an arched, banded inset. The stone wall is a vertical face, as expected under a roof. No receding side face is drawn.

style.evidence: The roof has about 4-5 green steps with scalloped rows and per-row highlights. The stone has 3-4 grey steps with a brick pattern and shaded joints. The outline is dark teal-green next to the roof and dark grey-violet next to the stone, with 0% neutral edge pixels, so it is tinted. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. Distinct colours (31) and median colours per tile (8) are below the references (66 and 185 distinct; 11 and 18 per tile), mainly because the stone has less speckle. The structure and craft still sit acceptably next to the stone reference house.
